definitions.gloss: daily, day-by-day, on a daily basis
definitions.explanation: Happening or done every day, or organized by individual days. Used especially in business and data contexts.

examples.japanese: {日次|にちじ}レポートを{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
{日次|にちじ}の{売上|うりあげ}データを{確認|かくにん}する。
このシステムは{日次|にちじ}でバックアップが{取|と}られる。
examples.english: This system is backed up on a daily basis.

notes:
FORMS:
{日|にち} (day) + {次|じ} (order, sequence) = day-by-day order, daily

SIMILAR TIME-FREQUENCY TERMS:
- {日次|にちじ}: daily
- {週次|しゅうじ}: weekly
- {月次|げつじ}: monthly
- {年次|ねんじ}: annual

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日次|にちじ}レポート: daily report
- {日次|にちじ}{処理|しょり}: daily processing
- {日次|にちじ}{集計|しゅうけい}: daily aggregation
- {日次|にちじ}バッチ: daily batch (IT)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with {日時|にちじ} (date and time), which has the same reading but different meaning and kanji. {日次|にちじ} is primarily a business and technical term.
